short_description: Entry-level LED/LCD. SDR-class brightness and contrast. Functional for everyday viewing; not suited for meaningful HDR or cinema comparison.

default_display_optics.contrast_notes: Typical IPS or VA LCD without quantum dot. Contrast range 800–2,000:1 depending on panel type; 1,500 used as estimate.

known_limitations: Peak HDR brightness (~300 nits) below the threshold for meaningful HDR impact — HDR10 badge is nominal at this tier
Color gamut limited to ~sRGB — cannot display full DCI-P3 cinema color
Contrast at 1,500:1 — blacks visibly gray in a dark room
